settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Appearance, alerts, IndiaMART, Tally and demo data.
settings.slaHint: A new lead not contacted within this time is flagged red.
settings.escalationHint: Untouched leads past this time appear on the owner dashboard.
settings.simulateHint: Demo mode: a new website enquiry arrives about every 90 seconds.
settings.soundHint: Play a soft chime when something new arrives.
settings.demoHint: Data lives in this browser. Resetting discards all changes and reloads fresh sample leads with dates relative to today.
settings.resetText: All current leads, activities and edits will be replaced.
settings.resetDoneText: Fresh leads loaded with dates relative to today.

integrations.title: IndiaMART and Tally
integrations.hint: IndiaMART buyers land here as leads and customers. Tally sales and stock can come in from a file, on a daily pull, or both ways.
integrations.keyHint: seller.indiamart.com → Lead Manager → ⋮ → Import/Export Leads → Pull API. The key stays on the server.
integrations.keySaved: A key is already saved. Paste a new one only to replace it.
integrations.pullText: {{created}} new leads, {{customers}} new customers, {{duplicates}} already here.
integrations.noLeads: IndiaMART has no new leads in the last 7 days.
integrations.webhookHint: In Lead Manager choose Other CRM and paste this address. IndiaMART only accepts a public https URL, so use it after this CRM is on the internet. Direct enquiries, buy leads, PNS calls, WhatsApp and catalog views all come in. GST and ratings stay inside IndiaMART.
integrations.tallyHint: Open the company in TallyPrime. F1 → Settings → Connectivity → set Tally as Server (port 9000). The books stay on this PC; this CRM talks to them only on your network.
integrations.nonePending: No won deals are waiting to be billed.
integrations.modeFileText: Export sales and stock from Tally as XML or Excel and load them here. No live link. Fine for a daily update.
integrations.modeOneText: The connector pulls new sales, customers, and stock from Tally on a schedule and writes them here. Reports and customer history then match the books.
integrations.modeTwoText: The CRM also posts invoices and new customers into Tally. Stock item names, the voucher type, and the GST ledger must match, or Tally rejects the voucher.
integrations.fileHint: In Tally use Display → Export or Alt+E. Export the Stock Summary and the Sales Register as XML or Excel.
integrations.synced: Books updated. {{invoices}} invoices, {{stock}} items, {{customers}} new customers.
integrations.dailyHint: Once a day, while this server and Tally are both open.
integrations.gstHint: Use the same names as Tally, for example Sales and Output CGST. Leave GST blank if this company does not post tax.
integrations.pushDaily: Also post into Tally each day
integrations.pushDailyHint: Off until you turn it on, so existing won deals are not written into the books by the daily run.
integrations.posted: {{sent}} invoices and {{customers}} customers sent to Tally.
